h1  
Design. Source. Deliver.

h2

More than interior design. We are your strategic sourcing partners. We combine an architect’s eye for detail with a robust export network, to bridge the gap between premium European manufacturing and your property in Spain. We source, advise, and export top-tier windows, doors, and furniture directly to the Costa Blanca. You get flawless European aesthetics, delivered and executed seamlessly under one studio.

**Premium Upholstery & Designer Furniture**  
Access to world-class sofas, beds, and seating. Poland is a global hub for furniture production, offering high-end fabrics and ergonomic designs that ensure maximum comfort and durability for high-traffic rentals.

**Bespoke Carpentry & Millwork**  
Custom-made kitchens, wardrobes, and built-in furniture crafted by masters of detail. We provide quality that competes with top-tier Italian brands.

**World-Class Window Systems**  
High-performance windows (including passive house standards) that offer superior insulation—crucial for the Spanish climate—delivered at competitive manufacturer prices.

**End-to-End Logistics: From Factory to Costa Blanca**

- **Sourcing & Negotiation** We secure the best prices directly from Polish factories.
- **Quality Control** We personally verify the standards of every item before it leaves the workshop.
- **Secure Logistics** We coordinate the entire transport process, ensuring your materials arrive safely and on time.

**Poland is currently one of the world’s leading exporters of high-quality furniture and construction materials. Our industry combines generations of craftsmanship with the most advanced manufacturing technologies in the world.**  
**For an investor in Spain, this means access to an unrivaled price-to-quality ratio. We deliver materials that far exceed local standards, often at a fraction of the cost found in the Spanish market. This isn’t about cutting corners—it’s about intelligent sourcing.**

**Our Network of Elite Partners**  
**We bypass middlemen and retail markups, offering you direct access to a curated network of exclusive Polish manufacturers and workshops. Our partnerships include:**
